form.why: P2 WCAG 4.1.3 (Codi FINAL, 2026-10-19): the live region is the Total line alone; the submit button leaves it. The div keeps data-catalogue-total and its class; prettier (printWidth 100) puts its two remaining attributes on one line.

lineEdits.from: /** Name heading level; card lists under a section h2 keep the default h3, the single-ticket page opts into h2. */
lineEdits.to: /** Name element; card lists under a section h2 keep the default h3, the checkout summary opts into p (its name repeats the page h1, r18). */

card.why:
P3 option (a): the summary card title is a non-heading

with the same class (nk-name), so identical styling; 'h2' had no other user and is removed rather than left dead.

page.why: P3 (a) at the call site; the breadcrumb and its JSON-LD are insertions only: every other BASE line survives, in order.

hero.why: An optional crumbs slot rendered as the first child of .nos-hero-copy, before the h1. Insertions only: no BASE line changes, so every other hero renders as at BASE.

css.why: Architect decision (f1-spec.md section 4): the checkout trail is five items; at 390px a non-wrapping flex row squeezes 'National Show' onto two lines and shrinks the separators (measured on BASE with the trail injected). flex-wrap lets the current item take the next line whole. The hub's two-item trail fits on one line at every width, so it renders as at BASE (nonreg.mjs holds /national-show/tickets). No token, colour or size is added. Amendment (Codi FINAL, 2026-10-19): a .nk-crumb unit binds each separator to the item after it (inline-flex, the nav's own 10px gap and centre alignment, so the hub renders as before); the separator may not shrink inside it.

masthead.why: Amendment: the hub's separator and current item become one nk-crumb unit, the same markup the checkout uses. Pixel-identical (nonreg holds /national-show/tickets).

crumbMarkup: nav.nk-crumbs[aria-label=Breadcrumb] > a[href=/national-show] 'National Show', span.nk-crumb > (span.nk-sep[aria-hidden=true], a[href=/national-show/tickets] 'Tickets'), span.nk-crumb > (span.nk-sep[aria-hidden=true], span[aria-current=page] {ticketType.name})
